name: Gates of Olympus

features.name: Tumble
features.description: Winning symbols are removed and new ones fall in, allowing several wins from one paid spin.

features.name: Multiplier orbs
features.description: Zeus drops orbs worth 2x–500x. In the base game they apply to the tumble sequence they land in.

features.name: Free spins
features.description: 4+ scatters award 15 free spins. Every multiplier that lands is added to a running total that applies to all wins for the rest of the round.

features.name: Ante bet / bonus buy
features.description: Ante bet raises the stake by 25% to double the scatter chance; the bonus buy costs 100x where permitted.

review:
The Zeus game that made pay-anywhere tumbles famous. No paylines: eight or more matching symbols anywhere on the 6x5 grid pay, and it keeps tumbling until no new wins form.

It all comes down to the multiplier orbs. In the base game they only boost the current tumble, so most spins are small or blank. In free spins, the multiplier total keeps building – that's where the big results come from. Expect long quiet spells: very high volatility, 5,000x max, 96.5% RTP.
pros: Simple to understand, very fast to play
Persistent free-spins multiplier creates real upside
cons: Base game can feel empty for long periods
Many casinos run a lower RTP configuration
5,000x cap is modest compared with newer high-variance games
